name: rich-emoji-search
title: Rich Emoji Search
description: Search the emojis textualize/rich exposes and paste either the emoji or its :name: console markup.
author: maxwell_ludden

commands.name: search-rich-emojis
commands.title: Search Rich Emojis
commands.subtitle: Search textualize/rich emojis
commands.description: Allows the user to fuzzy search for rich emojis.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
scripts.update-data: python3 scripts/update-emoji.py && python3 scripts/build-keywords.py && prettier --write src/emoji.json src/keywords.json
